guiding_rule: Introduce boundaries before moving storage. Preserve the current local-first experience and make every migration reversible.

database_decision.decision: A+B now: formal local domain model and repository boundary while retaining IndexedDB. Defer C: PostgreSQL/PostGIS implementation. Keep D: object storage as the later large-artifact path.
why: Current single-user local workflow is functional.
The main risk is mixed state ownership and opaque snapshots, not lack of a database.
Large datasets/results are better served by file/object boundaries than by a first-pass relational migration.
Remote persistence would require auth, conflict, retention, and operational decisions not requested in Concept 7A.
trigger_postgresql_postgis: Multi-user/project sharing is an accepted product requirement.
Remote durable Runs and job recovery are required.
Cross-device sync or server-side project queries are required.
Relational joins, AOI queries, or workspace ownership justify operational database cost.
trigger_object_storage: Users save coverage surfaces, ray traces, measurement files, or rendered reports for later retrieval.
Remote datasets exceed local-pack distribution or need content-addressed retention.
Run outputs must survive process restarts without inflating project metadata.

stages.name: Audit and freeze invariants
scope: Capture baseline and worktree attribution
Inventory state owners and IndexedDB paths
Define Project, Inventory, ScenarioRevision, Dataset, Run, Artifact, and Report boundaries
Record storage classification and conceptual schema
exit_criteria: Requested audit artifacts validate as JSON
No RF/optimizer/API behavior changed
Database decision and next phase are explicit
stages.rollback: Delete only the Concept 7A documentation artifacts; no runtime rollback required.

stages.name: Formal local domain model
scope: Introduce pure domain types/helpers for Project, Inventory, Scenario, ScenarioRevision, DatasetRef, Run, ArtifactRef, and ReportDefinition
Keep IndexedDB as the LocalRepository implementation
Translate the existing ProjectV2 envelope at the repository boundary
Define canonical resolved-input serialization and explicit null/inherit semantics
out_of_scope: Removing or rewriting existing IndexedDB data in place
stages.compatibility: Read schema v1/v2 and legacy envelopes; write the current compatible format plus a repository version marker.
exit_criteria: App no longer needs to know IndexedDB key/store details
ScenarioRevision can reconstruct current RF request inputs
UI-only state is excluded from domain serialization
Existing projectStore tests remain green
Round-trip export/import preserves current behavior
stages.rollback: Use the existing projectStore directly behind a feature flag or revert the new pure adapters; do not delete local records.

stages.name: Repository and run boundary
scope: Add repository interfaces for projects, scenarios, inventories, datasets, runs, artifacts, and reports
Represent current compute responses as transient Run results
Store Run metadata in local-first storage only when the user saves or when an audit workflow requests it
Add explicit Apply as Scenario semantics for optimization solutions
stages.compatibility: Existing compute endpoints remain stateless and accept the same request DTOs; adapters build resolved requests from domain snapshots.
exit_criteria: A completed optimization can be linked to a Run and selected solution
Applying a solution creates a new scenario/revision without mutating baseline inventory
Report generation consumes explicit scenario/run selections
Failed/cancelled runs have a clear local status model
stages.rollback: Disable durable Run capture and continue treating responses as session caches; preserve scenario snapshots.

stages.name: Optional server metadata store
scope: Implement PostgreSQL metadata tables from the conceptual schema
Add PostGIS only for AOI/inventory/geometry queries that need relational spatial operations
Add server repositories and project/scenario/run API routes
Keep Go RF runtime and dataset-pack loading independent of database row-per-ray storage
prerequisites: Stable domain repository contract from Stages 1-2
exit_criteria: Server repository round trips domain entities
Local-only mode still works
Run provenance and dataset references are queryable
No existing scenario becomes silently stale or rewritten
stages.rollback: Switch repository selection back to LocalRepository; server records remain read-only and versioned.

stages.name: Object/file artifact store
scope: Add content-addressed object storage abstraction
Upload dataset packs, measurement sources, coverage surfaces, ray traces, and reports only by explicit retention policy
Keep metadata and hashes in repository records
Support local filesystem/MinIO/S3-compatible implementations behind the same interface
exit_criteria: Large artifacts are not embedded in project metadata
Artifact references verify content hash and media type
Garbage collection respects live Run/report references
Downloads remain reproducible and permission checked
stages.rollback: Retain local generated artifacts or recompute from Run inputs; metadata references remain immutable.

stages.name: Sharing, sync, and collaboration
scope: Workspace/user ownership
Cross-device sync and outbox
Conflict UI for project/scenario/inventory revisions
Server-side job recovery and notifications
Audit and retention policy
exit_criteria: Conflict semantics are testable
Every mutation is attributable
Offline and online paths converge without lost scenario revisions
Deletion and artifact retention are observable
stages.rollback: Disable sync and operate in local-first mode; no destructive merge is automatic.

conflict_model.current: No distributed conflict model; local persistence revision only orders IndexedDB and localStorage fallback.
conflict_model.future_single_user: Last-write local working copy with immutable saved ScenarioRevisions.
conflict_model.future_multi_device: Optimistic concurrency on entity/revision version; immutable revisions avoid overwriting prior evidence; conflicts create explicit merge/duplicate choices.
never_automatic: Silently replacing a referenced dataset version
Overwriting an Inventory revision used by a ScenarioRevision
Deleting an artifact with live references

deletion_model.projects: Archive first; hard delete only after dependent scenarios/runs/reports/artifacts are handled.
deletion_model.scenarios: Archive or tombstone; retain revisions referenced by Runs/reports.
deletion_model.inventory: Create a new revision; do not edit historical revision contents.
deletion_model.runs: Retain terminal status by policy; do not overwrite.
deletion_model.artifacts: Reference-count/mark-and-sweep only after retention and audit checks.
deletion_model.local_indexeddb: Logical deletion inside normalized workspace; no separate orphan rows today.

reproducibility_gate: Exact ScenarioRevision or canonical resolved input
Dataset ids, versions, and content hashes
